verdict.rationale: Fathom's own marketing documents a bot-free capture option alongside bot capture, and the plans include unlimited recordings and transcriptions, so the core of the story is claimed. The bot-free mode is explicitly labeled beta, though, and nothing describes how it works. Missing for 10: documentation that audio is captured from the user's device, confirmation that external participants see nothing extra, non-beta status, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bot-free transcription.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra

citations.quote: Choice of bot-free (in beta) or bot capture
Fathom summarizes your meetings so you can focus on the conversation. Now available bot-free.
Capture notes your way – bot or no bot – so you can stay focused on the meeting
